title: Turn Do Not Disturb on or off in Settings

setup.why: Keep the phone's own zen mode once (0 off, 1 priority, 2 total silence, 3 alarms only), so teardown puts it back.
Start from the other state through NotificationManager (a plain `settings put` of zen_mode is reverted by ZenModeHelper), so the agent has to change it.
Open Settings at its home page, whatever screen an earlier run left it on.

instruction: Using the Settings app, turn Do Not Disturb {{mode.say}}.

checks.why: global/zen_mode is 0 when Do Not Disturb is off and 1, 2 or 3 when it is on (priority, total silence, alarms only: any of them is on). Setup left the other state, so an agent that does nothing fails.

teardown.why: Put the phone's own Do Not Disturb state back from the saved zen mode, and drop the saved copy.

argv: f=/data/local/tmp/computer-bench-{{nonce}}.orig; v=$(cat $f 2>/dev/null); case "$v" in 1) m=priority ;; 2) m=none ;; 3) m=alarms ;; *) m=off ;; esac; cmd notification set_dnd $m; rm -f $f
